message:
fix(app): add missing Delete All Receipts option to Settings

Settings had no way to delete actual vault data — "Clear scan data"
only wiped the scan-accuracy telemetry ledger, a separate on-device
metric. Adds a Data section with a destructive-confirmation delete-all
action: cancels every purchase's pending alerts, deletes them (receipt
images included), and republishes the widget digest as empty.
